decisions.reason: As a core-adjacent product line with an earlier dedicated webpage, several years of sunk engineering and market commitment make management likely to continue it unless there is clear failure.
Even with lower website prominence, it supports the firm's stated automation direction, so disappointing performance can still be justified as part of a longer strategic build-out.
This visibly committed product line sits close to the established formwork business, which encourages continued support rather than withdrawal in an expanding firm.
Its own webpage and fit with the existing formwork portfolio create reputational and sunk-cost pressures to retain it, though it is somewhat easier to prune than the broader product lines.
Although still close to the core offer, its lower visibility and narrower commitment make it the easiest remaining product to drop, but escalation of commitment still favors keeping it for now.
